name: Risen demon
description: a gaunt dark demon of the Cracked Road, charred black with cracked skin that glows orange as embers beneath, smoke trailing off the shoulders, looks like it has been dead before

poses.stand: standing slouched, ember glow in its cracked skin, smoke rising, facing right
poses.struck: struck: knocked back, cracks flaring bright orange
poses.dead: fallen on its back, cracks dimming to grey ash, ready to rise again

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
